ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a wedding with {OTHER_nameDef}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Engaged colonists want to get married. The game holds the ceremony on its own sooner or later; promise the wish and the council holds it as soon as both are ready and the day is calm (no danger, no breakdown). A marriage spot gives it a place.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I want to get married. A proper ceremony, with all of you there.
We've been engaged long enough. Let's have the wedding while things are quiet.
[afterraid] I watched {OTHER_nameDef} in the thick of it today. I'm done waiting to marry {OTHER_objective}.
[spring] Spring's a good time for a wedding. There'll be flowers to pick.
[winter] Let's marry this winter, with all of us bundled up in our warmest clothes.

warm.li: I want to stand up in front of all of you and promise {OTHER_nameDef} the rest of my life.

blunt.li: We're getting married. Pick a day.

cheerful.li: A wedding, with flowers and speeches and somebody crying at the back! I can't wait.

gloomy.li: Out here, you never know how long you've got. I'd rather be married when it ends.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I wish to formalize the arrangement.

plain.li: I'm married. I keep saying it to myself to hear how it sounds.
[spring] A spring wedding, with flowers in everyone's hair. Best day I've had here.

cheerful.li: We're married! Did you see? I want to tell everyone who missed it.

plain.li: We'll put the wedding off a while longer.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a {SUBJECT}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A birthday is coming. A fine meal, a lavish one, or a party would make it a day to remember.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {PAWN_nameDef} eats a fine or lavish meal, eats in an impressive dining room, or attends a party in the next few days.

plain.li: It's my birthday soon. A good meal would do, and a few people around the table.
Another year older, and still alive out here. That deserves a proper meal, doesn't it?
[old] At my age, every birthday is one more than I expected. Let's eat well for it.
[child] It's my birthday soon! Can we have a party, with everybody there?
[winter] My birthday always falls in the cold months, when the food's thinnest. A good meal this year would mean a lot.
[lowmood] I'd like one day this season that feels good. My birthday would do.

warm.li: I don't need presents. Just the people I like at one table, and something nice to eat.

blunt.li: My birthday's this week. Cook something good.

cheerful.li: Guess whose birthday it is soon! We should have cake, or whatever passes for cake around here.

gloomy.li: Another year gone, and I can't say it was a good one. A decent meal might help.

cold.li: My birthday approaches. A celebratory meal would be appropriate.

plain.li: Best birthday I've had in years.
[old] I've had a lot of birthdays. This one I'll remember.

cheerful.li: Thank you! Same again next year?

plain.li: Just another day, then.
[child] I thought somebody would remember my birthday.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: art for their bedroom
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A sculpture or other piece of art in their own room: something beautiful to wake up to.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: The art is gone from {FOR_nameDef}'s bedroom.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: A piece of art stands in {PAWN_nameDef}'s bedroom.

plain.li: Could I have a sculpture in my room? Something to look at besides the walls.
[skill:Artistic] I make art all day for everyone else. Just once, I'd like a piece for my own room.
[trait:Greedy] My room has a bed and nothing worth looking at. A good piece of art would fix that.
[rich] There are sculptures sitting in the storeroom. One of them could stand in my room.

warm.li: Even a small carving by the bed would be lovely to wake up to.

blunt.li: My walls are ugly. Fix that.

cheerful.li: A sculpture in my room! I'd say good morning to it every day.

gloomy.li: There isn't much in my life that's beautiful. One piece of art in my room would be a start.

cold.li: Art increases room impressiveness. I would like mine increased.

plain.li: I keep stopping to look at it on my way out in the morning.

cheerful.li: I named it. It's called Gerald!

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: more time to rest
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: This colonist wants more recreation hours in their schedule, set in the Schedule tab.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: {FOR_nameDef}'s hours of rest have been taken off the schedule again.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {PAWN_nameDef}'s schedule has at least {TARGET} hours of recreation.

plain.li: I haven't had a moment to myself in days. Could I have a few hours off?
Work, sleep, work. I need something in between.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] I know, it's not like me to ask. Just one afternoon.
[winter] It's a long winter. Let me spend some of it doing something other than work.
[afterraid] We just survived another attack. Let me sit down for a while before the next job.

warm.li: I'll work all the harder afterward, I promise. I just need some rest.

blunt.li: I'm tired. Give me time off or watch me fall asleep on the job.

cheerful.li: A whole afternoon of doing nothing! Wouldn't that be lovely?

gloomy.li: I'm running on empty. I keep making mistakes I wouldn't make rested.

cold.li: Productivity declines without rest. I am requesting rest.

plain.li: An afternoon to myself. I slept, then I ate, then I slept again.

cheerful.li: Free time! I'm going to waste it magnificently.

plain.li: I'll keep working until I drop, I suppose.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: something to drink or smoke
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist with a taste for chemicals wants beer, smokeleaf or a similar social drug kept in stock.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has at least {TARGET} social drugs (beer, smokeleaf joints and the like) in stock.

plain.li: There's nothing left to drink or smoke in the whole storeroom.
A barrel of beer would do a lot for morale. Mine especially.
[afterraid] My hands are still shaking from the fight. A drink would help.
[winter] The nights are long and cold, and there's nothing to take the edge off them.

warm.li: A few bottles to pass around in the evening. It'd do us all good.

blunt.li: Stock some beer. Or smokeleaf. I'm not fussy.

cheerful.li: Who's up for brewing a batch? I'll help with the drinking part!

gloomy.li: Everything's easier to bear with a drink in hand.

cold.li: Recreational substances reduce stress. Ours are depleted.

plain.li: Ah. Now that's more like it.

cheerful.li: Cheers, all of you! First round's on the colony.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {OTHER_nameDef} joining the colony
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist has taken a liking to a prisoner and wants them to become one of you.

plain.li: I've been talking with {OTHER_nameDef} in the evenings. I think we should bring {OTHER_objective} in.
{OTHER_nameDef} could be one of us. We could use the hands, and I could use the company.
[small] There are only a few of us. {OTHER_nameDef} would make a difference.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} hasn't given the wardens any trouble since we took {OTHER_objective} in. Let's give {OTHER_objective} a place here.

blunt.li: Recruit {OTHER_nameDef} already. Stop wasting good food on a prisoner.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} told me the funniest story through the bars. We need more people like that!

gloomy.li: We need every pair of hands we can get, even ones that were shooting at us last week.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has useful skills. Recruitment is the efficient outcome.

plain.li: Welcome, {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll show you where everything is.
{OTHER_nameDef} stays a prisoner, then. I'll keep talking to {OTHER_objective} anyway.
